html:
Hello folks.  Thanks to all of you early readers who have hustled to get feedback to me on the draft version of Wormhole.  We’ve finally reached agreement with my new publisher on the final contract wording and I hope to have the contract signed shortly after everyone returns to work from the holidays.  Until that happens, I’m leaving open the early reader feedback program.  Best holiday wishes and a happy new year to you all.
Best,
Richard

comments.author: bitmite
comments.html: I loved the draft version, thank you for the opportunity to read it.

comments.author: Jim
comments.html: Can’t wait for the final installment. I enjoyed the first two immensely. What’s next after this project?

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Thanks Jim. Right now I’m working on a Jack “The Ripper” Gregory prequel and after that I plan on doing a few novels that follow some of the surviving Rho Agenda characters and the changed world in which they find themselves.

comments.author: Ben Pine
comments.html:
Dear Richard , your first two books are awesome. Can I sign up to read the draft of Wormhole please?
Best wishes
Ben

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Ben. Yes you can. Here’s what I need you to do.
1. Go to the Manage Your Kindle page on Amazon.com
a. Click on the link on the left hand side that says Personal Document Settings
b. Add my email account to the Approved Personal Document E-mail List([email removed])

2. Click on the Manage Your Devices link on the left
a. Send me the Kindle E-mail Address for your kindle ([email removed]).
It will end in @kindle.com

If you don’t have a real kindle, just email me ( [email removed] ) and I’ll send you the PDF file.
Happy Holidays.

comments.author: Ryan
comments.html: Thank you so much for the chance to be an early reader. This series of books has easily been my favorite since I read the first book. I am a huge fan and look forward to new entries in this universe. Easily the best books I’ve read for a very long time.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: You’re welcome. Best wishes for a happy new year for you and your family.

comments.author: jkat
comments.html:
My Phillips – a Happy New year to you and heres looking forward to an exciting year with hopefully another successful series of book releases! Thanks for giving me early access to Book 3 – which I absolutely loved!

Cant wait for whats next!

Richard,

Great books. Read through them pretty fast and was left hungering for more. Have shared these with my daughter and some friends. There is no interest here in reading the draft, but think its pretty cool you are allowing users to preview your work like that.
